2609.03350.title: From Zero to Hero: An Open LLM Ecosystem for Armenian
2609.03350.paper_summary: Pretraining data for Armenian, a morphologically rich and low-resource language, is scarce, and no open Armenian LLM has been released with the data and recipe needed to reproduce it. To address this gap, we curate and release two datasets. ArmWeb is an extensively validated corpus of 4.37M Armenian news documents. ArmSTEM is a parallel English-Armenian collection of 373K math and science problems with step-by-step solutions, translated into Armenian and verified through both answer-preserving LLM judgment and human evaluation. Continued pretraining of Gemma-4-E4B on these datasets yields arm-gemma-e4b, which outperforms every existing open Armenian model as well as its unadapted base, and is the first open Armenian LLM with complete training data and recipe. Our ablations show that news-only continued pretraining improves fluency while eroding knowledge, a pattern we also observe in existing Armenian models, and that a small share of verified translated STEM data reverses the loss. We further find that the largest public Armenian corpora overlap web-derived evaluation panels heavily, including a train/test self-overlap inside FineWeb-2. We openly release all data, models, and code.
2609.03350.paper_summary_zh: 預訓練資料對於亞美尼亞語這種形態豐富且資源稀缺的語言來說非常稀少，且尚未有公開的亞美尼亞LLM釋出所需的資料和配方來重現它。為了填補這一空白，我們整理並釋出兩個數據集。ArmWeb是一個經過廣泛驗證的亞美尼亞新聞文檔語料庫，包含4.37M篇文檔。ArmSTEM是一個373K數學和科學問題的英亞雙語平行集合，附有逐步解答，已翻譯成亞美尼亞語並通過保留答案的LLM判斷和人工評估進行驗證。對這些數據集持續進行Gemma-4-E4B的預訓練，產生了arm-gemma-e4b，該模型在所有現有的公開亞美尼亞模型中表現最佳，並且超越了其未適應的基礎模型，成為第一個擁有完整訓練資料和配方的公開亞美尼亞LLM。我們的消融實驗顯示，僅基於新聞的持續預訓練提高了流暢性，但削弱了知識，這一模式在現有的亞美尼亞模型中也有觀察到，而少量經過驗證的翻譯STEM數據則能逆轉這一損失。我們進一步發現，最大的公共亞美尼亞語料庫與網絡衍生的評估面板有很大重疊，包括FineWeb-2內部的訓練/測試自重疊。我們公開釋出所有數據、模型和代碼。
